overview_description.description:
Pops is an Android application that enables mobile users to personalize their phone alerts, including new email, SMS, Facebook, Twitter, Google+, WhatsApp & more in a fun and innovative way. Pops created the first technology that enables the capture of any incoming notification on a mobile device operating system or cloud-based service, then customizes the notification with a new kind of media: Pops media.
 
Pops media is a 5 second animation or video clip that precedes or wraps the notification itself. Pops maintains a gallery of 1000s of animations and clips to choose from.
